name: roster-change-makes-merge-wait
invariant: A roster change after carry-over was selected makes the merge wait: the merge re-validates against its subject's currently selected review-requirement revision when its effect is intended, so an attestation made under the old revision is refused (stale_expected_state) and nothing is pushed; the next generation's carry_over demands the replacement review, and its merge waits for it (13 "Merge-queue generations").
